sloka: पूर्वं कृतयुगे तात पर्वताः पक्षिणोऽभवन् ।ते हि जग्मुर्दिशः सर्वा गरुडानिलवेगिनः ॥५-१-१२३॥
transliteration: pūrvaṁ kṛtayuge tāta parvatāḥ pakṣiṇo'bhavan ।te hi jagmurdiśaḥ sarvā garuḍānilaveginaḥ ॥5-1-123॥

translations.english: "Formerly in Kritayuga, O dear, mountains were endowed with wings. They used to move speedily in all directions like Garuda and the Windgod.
